records.rationale: Scenario label reserved for a future elicitation and sensitivity process; no shape, parameters or ordering selected.
limitations: Contextual official and SME evidence does not make this assumption empirical.
Conservative has no safety meaning; central is not a population mean; high-tempo is not a quantile.
No numeric scenario parameters are authorized in V0.3.

uncertainties.rationale: A sampling frame and complete years are absent.
uncertainties.future_aleatory_component: Variation among comparable unit-years after conditioning on training cycle.
uncertainties.future_epistemic_component: Unknown reporting coverage, year completeness and policy applicability.
uncertainties.propagation_plan: Keep between-year variation separate from missingness; compare scenario results without pooled truth claims.

uncertainties.rationale: Exercise totals do not identify person or crew event counts.
uncertainties.future_aleatory_component: Variation by ammunition, mission and exercise conditional on shared training cycle.
uncertainties.future_epistemic_component: Missing event boundaries and crew allocation.
uncertainties.propagation_plan: Retain original totals, strict/approximate qualifiers and joint event context; never divide by assumed crews.

uncertainties.rationale: Attendance and round-by-round participation are unavailable.
uncertainties.future_aleatory_component: Rotation and absences within comparable events if empirically documented.
uncertainties.propagation_plan: Model membership and attendance separately from firing counts only after authorization and denominator review.

uncertainties.rationale: MOS does not identify a person's role at each event.
uncertainties.future_aleatory_component: Within-person role changes if a valid process is established.
uncertainties.future_epistemic_component: Unrecorded role and changes across assignments.
uncertainties.propagation_plan: Retain categorical unknown; do not default everyone to operator or sample invented role probabilities.

uncertainties.rationale: Proximity, orientation, attendance and valid measurements are missing.
uncertainties.propagation_plan: Keep potential nearby presence separate from counted exposure and pressure; unknown is not zero.

uncertainties.rationale: No individual assignment histories are curated.
uncertainties.propagation_plan: Preserve date intervals and censoring; never prorate annual activity uniformly without explicit assumptions.

uncertainties.rationale: Absence of a public report is not a zero-event year.
uncertainties.propagation_plan: Carry observed/unknown/not-applicable years separately; sensitivity to missingness must be explicit.

uncertainties.rationale: Indexed originals, recollection and source conflicts limit support.
uncertainties.future_epistemic_component: Retrieval, measurement, transcription, recall and selective-reporting uncertainty.
uncertainties.propagation_plan: Use source-specific alternatives and exclusion sensitivity; do not invent a universal reliability weight.
